headline: Everything we know about Brian Cole, the DC pipe bombing suspect
trending_claim: Attorney General Pam Bondi asserts the five-year pipe-bomb investigation "languished" under Biden for four years, that the FBI had all the needed evidence the whole time, and that the Trump DOJ cracked the case through diligent police work — a claim now being paired on the right with Tucker Carlson's interview of Cole's parents, who say he was framed.
trending_context: Featured among Fox News's top homepage stories on Sep 27, 2026, alongside a Jeanine Pirro segment revealing new details; the pardon-motion fight over whether Trump's Jan. 6 clemency covers Cole keeps the case alive in right-wing discussion.

headline: Trump to set new fuel economy standards and undo Biden-era 'EV mandate'
trending_claim: Trump announced Saturday he has approved new fuel economy standards that terminate the Biden-era EV mandate, claiming the old rules cost automakers billions and that the new ones will mean lower car prices and manufacturing jobs returning to Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, and South Carolina.
trending_context: Leading story on the Washington Examiner on Sep 27 and carried by memeorandum (NYT: administration moves Monday to sharply scale back fuel-efficiency rules).

headline: Iran ready for 'doomsday war' after Trump rejects ceasefire, foreign minister says
trending_claim: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned Iran is prepared for a "doomsday war" after Trump publicly rejected Tehran's ceasefire offer Saturday (a halt to Hormuz attacks plus resumed nuclear talks in exchange for lifting the U.S. naval blockade); the WSJ reports Trump told aides he expects to resume intensive bombing after the midterms.
trending_context: Top Washington Examiner story on Sep 27, 2026; the rejected Saturday ceasefire offer and the doomsday-war threat are the dominant foreign-policy story in right-leaning media this weekend.

headline: Trump takes aim at DEI and noncitizen programs in $1 billion pocket rescission
trending_claim: Trump canceled nearly $1 billion in unspent federal funding ($810 million via a rare pocket rescission) on Sep 25, targeting immigration/refugee, DEI, foreign debt-relief, minority-business, and research/education programs — only the second pocket rescission in 50 years, and GOP Sen. Susan Collins says it unlawfully undermines Congress's power of the purse.
trending_context: Top Washington Examiner story Sep 26 and widely covered across right-wing media (NY Post, WLT Report) as Trump uses a rarely deployed budget power five days before the fiscal year ends.

headline: Fetterman Rejects Party-Switch Talk, Dodges 51st-Vote Query
trending_claim: At the Texas Tribune Festival on Saturday, Sen. John Fetterman said Democratic control of the Senate was "entirely possible" but refused to say how he would vote if he became the decisive 51st senator, saying "let's revisit after the midterms."
trending_context: Fresh Sep 27 right-leaning coverage (Newsmax) of Fetterman's party-defection saga — the same Democrat who cast the lone Democratic vote against the Iran war powers resolution is now the pivot of midterm Senate math.

headline: Senate Rejects Latest Bid to Curb Trump's Iran War Powers
trending_claim: The Senate defeated the Iran war powers resolution 50-49 on Thursday: four Republicans (Rand Paul, Susan Collins, Lisa Murkowski, Thom Tillis) voted for it, Democrat John Fetterman was the lone Democrat voting against it, and the measure died because it needed 51 votes.
trending_context: Carried across right-leaning media (Newsmax, Washington Examiner); Fetterman's lone Democratic no vote against his own party's resolution made the close vote a headline story.

headline: Facing a barrage of Republican anti-trans ads, some Democrats are changing how they respond
trending_claim: Democrats in competitive midterms — including James Talarico (TX Senate), Rep. Marcy Kaptur (OH), and Amy Acton (OH governor) — are now publicly opposing trans athletes in girls' sports or trans ideology after GOP advertisers spent more than $60 million on 190+ transgender-focused TV ads this year, per AdImpact.
trending_context: Sep 27 story trending hard in right-leaning media (PoliticalWire, right-wing blogs) as evidence the GOP's trans-ads strategy is forcing Democrats to concede the issue.
